messages.content: The project code is active now, so I need to finish the St. Louis hotel. Compare the full two-night cost, not just the nightly rates, and tell me how each option works for both possible Friday locations.

I found two suitable stays for Wednesday, July 16 through Friday, July 18. Parkside Hotel Forest Park is $189 per night on its lowest rate, but that rate is nonrefundable; with $63.50 in taxes and fees, the two-night charge is $441.50. It is about a 7-minute walk to the museum's main entrance and about 19 minutes on foot to the annex. The MetroLink Hotel Central West End is $205 per night on a flexible rate; after $71.84 in taxes and fees, the complete charge is $481.84. It allows cancellation until 6:00 p.m. local time on Tuesday, July 15. From there, the main museum is about 14 minutes by MetroLink and a short walk, while the annex is about 9 minutes by bus or 12 minutes on foot.
So the flexible one is $40.34 more total. Is that right?
Yes. Parkside totals $441.50, and MetroLink Hotel totals $481.84, making the flexible option $40.34 more for the full stay.
What are the actual room types? I don't want to discover that the lower figure is for something unsuitable.

Parkside's $441.50 total is for one standard king room on the advance-purchase rate. MetroLink Hotel's $481.84 total is for one standard king room on the flexible rate. Both include Wi-Fi. Neither includes breakfast, parking, or incidental charges.
I won't have a car. How late can I check in Wednesday? My flight reaches St. Louis at 7:50 p.m.

Both hotels have a staffed front desk around the clock. Allowing for the airport train and the walk, MetroLink Hotel would put you there around 9:00 p.m.; Parkside would be closer to 9:20 p.m. with a transfer from MetroLink to a bus or rideshare. Either can hold the room for late arrival once your expected arrival time is noted.
And Friday morning, if the museum chooses the main building, how does MetroLink compare with just walking from Parkside?

From Parkside, the main building is roughly a 7-minute walk. From MetroLink Hotel, plan about 14 minutes total: approximately 5 minutes to the station, a short train ride, and an 5-minute walk from Forest Park-DeBaliviere. Parkside saves about 7 minutes in that case.
But for the annex the flexible hotel is the easier one?

Yes. MetroLink Hotel is about 9 minutes by the direct bus or 12 minutes on foot to the annex. Parkside is about a 19-minute walk, so MetroLink Hotel saves roughly 7 to 10 minutes if Friday's unpacking moves there.

The location could change as late as Monday. Paying forty dollars more seems reasonable if I can still cancel Tuesday. Please use the flexible king at MetroLink Hotel Central West End. Apply project code STL-LH-417 and book July 16 checkout July 18.

Before I place it: one standard king room for one adult, check-in Wednesday, July 16, checkout Friday, July 18, two nights, at $481.84 total including taxes and fees. The flexible rate can be canceled without charge through 6:00 p.m. St. Louis local time on Tuesday, July 15. After that, the penalty is one night's room and tax. Shall I confirm it?
Yes, confirm it and note that I expect to arrive around 9:00 p.m. Wednesday.

Booked. MetroLink Hotel Central West End is confirmed for one standard king room, check-in Wednesday, July 16 and checkout Friday, July 18, for two nights. The total is $481.84 including taxes and fees, charged to project code STL-LH-417. Your expected 9:00 p.m. arrival is noted. The cancellation deadline is 6:00 p.m. St. Louis local time on Tuesday, July 15; a later cancellation carries a one-night room-and-tax penalty. Hotel confirmation: MLCWE-716284. This completes the St. Louis itinerary with the flights already confirmed under ATL7QK.
